I can't say who ran the fantasy football league or who won it. I can't search or read the mail in this session, and I don't have a reliable recollection of that thread, so I'd be guessing at names.

- Fantasy football chatter is known to exist in the Enron corpus. It tends to show up in traders' and analysts' mailboxes, particularly in the autumn football seasons of 2000 and 2001, and it often takes the form of league standings, trade proposals and Yahoo league notices.
- I can't tie a specific commissioner or champion to any message, date or quote, so I won't name anyone.

To pin it down, search the 1999–2001 mail for "fantasy football", "commissioner", "standings" and "league champion". The commissioner is usually the person who sends the weekly standings or the league rules. The winner is usually named in an end-of-season message around late December or early January.

Answer in plain words, without headings: a short opening line with the answer, then the evidence as a few sentences or a short list, with dates, names and short quotes. If you don't know, say so plainly instead of guessing.
